title: Mimi Shares How Moving House Impacts Her Sex Life and Desire for More Variety
text: Mimi Shares How Moving House Impacts Her Sex Life and Desire for More Variety Mimi a 30-year-old content creator in Shrewsbury discusses how the stress of moving house significantly reduces her sex drive and libido. She describes her typical routine and the challenge of finding time for intimacy while exhausted from packing. Despite the fatigue she values her husbands tender care and expresses a desire for a more adventurous and varied sex life beyond their current routine. This week we hear from Mimi*, a 30-year-old married content creator in Shrewsbury, who typically has sex four times a week. ‘I like having sex with my husband but could happily go days without it,’ Mimi says. ‘My libido is generally dictated by what’s happening in my life, how stressed I am, so with us in the process of moving house, we haven’t been having it very often. ‘I’d like my sex life to be a bit more varied. We fall into doing the same things over and over it can get a bit repetitive.I wish we were a bit more adventurous. ’‘My sex drive goes way down when I’m tired, so I know adding a baby into that is just going to see me turn into a completely sexless being,’ she says. I’d never understood why everyone says moving house is one of life’s most stressful events. But, now I’m pulling my hair out while we wait the last few days for the keys to our new place. After five years, my husband and I are swapping our two-bedroom new-build for a three-bedroom 70s semi.We’ve outgrown our first house and after six months of waiting, we are finally due to move this week. , we’ve left packing until the last minute so the house is a whirlwind of bubble wrap and bin bags. Between all the boxes, I barely have time to pee, never mind think about sex. After 17 hours of packing, I’m fast asleep as soon as I hit the pillow.Once I get home from work, I change out of my work clothes and into pyjamas, ready to tackle the kitchen. We finally crawl into bed, exhausted. We kiss and cuddle up together, but I’m too tired for much more. Taking the lead, Harry fingers me.I can’t keep my eyes open, but he keeps checking I want it before touching me tenderly until I orgasm. Our last night in the house doesn’t feel sad. I’m over it at this point, having your whole life packed up into boxes and IKEA bags gives you a weird feeling. Our bed was dismantled and sent to the tip.We’d broken it months ago so it’s not worth keeping. I wish I could say it broke because of our voracious sex life, but really it was a cheap Argos bed that lived way longer than it had any business doing. So, it’s a living room sleepover for us! I’m on the sofa, and Harry is on the floor, surrounded by boxes.Unable to sleep from excitement, his hand sneaks up and he pulls me on top of him, kissing and touching me all over. All the stress from the last week evaporates as the horniness takes over. I end up on my back on the floor, wedged between the sofa and a pile of boxes, legs akimbo resting on top of the cardboard.It’s a bit claustrophobic, and I can’t actually move or do anything since I’m truly jammed in, but with the boxes to rest on, my legs are high in the air making for an amazing angle as he thrusts on top of me. This must be what its like to have a sex swing, a couple of boxes has me feeling like a gymnast.It feels great, and I know my husband feels the same as he comes quickly, both of us trying not to laugh at how silly we must look. It’s moving day! Between the early start and the nerves, I’m tired but things go as well as they could’ve. I only cry twice, and suddenly we’re in our new house, surrounded by chaos with no idea where we put the kettle.We spend a few hours rummaging for the essentials but the big problem comes when I want nothing more than to curl up into bed. Despite careful planning, the new bed has not been delivered. So, I curl up on the floor, using sofa cushions and blankets to build a nest. It’s not the most romantic sleeping arrangement, so when Harry sidles over to grab my boob, I shut him down quickly.I’m straight back to work today, after storming round the house looking for my shoes and figuring out how the shower works. I leave my husband snoring on the floor. Walking back in through the front door at 6 pm is a treat. Harry has managed to unpack the whole kitchen and make the living room livable, so the house doesn’t feel like a bomb site.His hard work is rewarded as I go down on him on the sofa. He tries to take it further, pulling me up onto him and swiftly taking off my top in the same motion. But as I start grinding on him, the couch screams out an almighty clunk like it was going to give way any second, so sex is swiftly abandoned. Movies make painting a house look fun and romantic.You think it’s going to be splattering paint on each other in between snogs, when in reality you stand there in your scruffiest clothes having arguments holding a paint roller. With no sexy distractions, we paint the entire downstairs. We reward ourselves with a beer and a shag. We start up against a door, kissing and moaning as he pushes my paint-covered shorts down, before fully just doing it on the floor since our bed still hasn’t been delivered.I’m on my hands and knees with him behind me, but he complains of getting friction burn on his knees so we swap to me riding him. It’s a nice distraction to the chaos, and it feels good to have some actual intimacy, even if I’m missing a real bed. But, I don’t celebrate for long, as the delivery men won’t carry it upstairs.Cue an argument between Harry and I as we get snippy while we lumber the headboard around. We don’t normally argue. We genuinely are pretty easy going, but the stress of the move gets to us I suppose. I hate feeling like we’re not on the same side.I know it’s the situation, but a disconnect between us is something I really don’t like.
